decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-146 MODIFY already adds "directly on the NFT" to the FAQ referral-code locations, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
Displaying the referral code directly on an NFT does not change which NFT state transfers to a secondary buyer.
Referral-code visibility on the NFT does not change Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility, transfer, counters, or expiration.
The referral code remains the permanent NFT mint number; adding an on-NFT display location does not alter its identity or permanence.
Referral-code visibility on the NFT does not change Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, transfer, counters, or expiration.
Displaying a referral code directly on an NFT does not change commission allocation when no referral code is entered.
The new referral-code display location does not change primary-mint pricing or revenue allocation.
Adding direct on-NFT visibility does not remove or modify the optional referral-code content of the confirmation email.
Displaying the referral code on the NFT does not change the direct referral commission's amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout mode.
The on-NFT referral-code display does not change random ticket allocation when no referral code is used.
Referral-code visibility on an NFT does not change Big Block prize amounts, draw triggers, funding, qualifying sales, or winner eligibility.
Displaying the referral code directly on the NFT does not change wallet requirements for fiat minting, commissions, ticket holding, or secondary trading.
